import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='sBGaYvw'].copy()
pre = a[a.date<'2025-10-19']
post = a[a.date>='2025-10-19']
g1 = pre.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family']).agg(cost=('unblended_cost','sum'), days=('date','nunique'))
g2 = post.groupby(['cloud_service','application','instance_family']).agg(cost=('unblended_cost','sum'), days=('date','nunique'))
m = (g1.assign(avg1=g1.cost/g1.days).join(g2.assign(avg2=g2.cost/g2.days), lsuffix='_pre', rsuffix='_post'))
m['diff']=m.avg2-m.avg1
print(m.sort_values('diff', ascending=False).head(20))
print("---- new in post ----")
print(g2[~g2.index.isin(g1.index)])

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

    s = piv[t]
    base = s.loc[:'2025-10-18']
    z = (s - base.mean())/base.std()
    print(t)
    print(z.loc['2025-10-17':'2025-10-23'].round(2))
